claim: On 72 manifest-named PyArmor v8/v9 default-trial wrappers, disrobe statically decrypts each body and decodes one complete root CodeObject from its header-anchored marshal stream.
gate_source: crates/disrobe-pass-pyarmor/tests/static_unpack_corpus.rs named_v8_v9_default_trial_wrappers_decode_complete_root_code_objects binds the typed MANIFEST.toml roster to the discovered v8/v9 chunk-wrapper set, verifies each manifest-declared wrapper/runtime pair, checks the default-trial serial, statically decrypts every named wrapper, computes the header-declared marshal start, requires the public helper to agree, and requires disrobe-py-marshal to decode one complete root CodeObject. This self-reported structural check does not compare source, emitted pyc bytes, execution, semantic equivalence, or external-tool output.
measured: 72 decoded root CodeObjects / 72 named v8/v9 default-trial wrappers

oracle.external: none: the typed manifest and discovered v8/v9 wrapper set define the population; file identities, static decryption, and complete root-CodeObject parsing are checked in-tree. No external source, emitted pyc, execution, or tool comparison grades the result.
oracle.note: The result is limited to manifest-named v8/v9 default-trial wrappers. It does not cover v6/v7, unlisted v8/v9 wrappers, registered-license/pro, BCC, or super mode.
